about.heading: About Me
about.bio: I'm a Full Stack Developer with over 9 years of experience building technology solutions across diverse industries. My career spans web and mobile applications, game development, IoT integration, and digital signage platforms. I'm passionate about tackling complex technical challenges and turning them into functional products that deliver real impact. Every project is an opportunity to learn, innovate, and deliver results that exceed expectations.
